en: Hand-colored postcard showing a formal military scene outside a large stone barracks building. Two lines of uniformed soldiers with rifles stand facing each other, apparently during a changing of the guard. On the right is a guardhouse with a soldier standing at attention. Leafless or early-spring trees are visible in the background beyond an open parade ground. Text in German is printed in red at the bottom margin.
